Title: Session persistence after refresh
Preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user on /inventory.html
Test Steps:
1. Log in as standard_user
2. Navigate to /inventory.html
3. Refresh the page (F5)
4. Observe page state
Expected Result: User remains on /inventory.html; session is preserved; products are displayed
